stanzas.sanskrit:
पृथोस्तु नप्ता पृथुधर्मकर्मठः
प्राचीनबर्हिर्युवतौ शतद्रुतौ ।
प्रचेतसो नाम सुचेतसः सुता-
-नजीजनत् त्वत्करुणाङ्कुरानिव ॥ १९-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
Prithu's great grandson, Praacheenbarhis was noble and just. He was married to Shathadruti, who gave birth to ten noble sons collectively called as Prachetas. They were with good deeds and thoughts.

Prithu
Vijithaasvan
Havirdhaanan
Pracheenabarhis
Prachetas - 10
stanzas.stanza_roman:
pṛthostu naptā pṛthudharmakarmaṭhaḥ
prācīnabarhiryuvatau śatadrutau |
pracetaso nāma sucetasaḥ sutā-
-najījanat tvatkaruṇāṅkurāniva || 19-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
पितुः सिसृक्षानिरतस्य शासना-
-द्भवत्तपस्याभिरता दशाऽपि ते ।
पयोनिधिं पश्चिममेत्य तत्तटे
सरोवरं सन्ददृशुर्मनोहरम् ॥ १९-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: As per their father's advice, the 10 sons Prachetas, indulged themselves in Lord's worship and went to the western ocean to do penance and reached a beautiful lake.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
pituḥ sisṛkṣāniratasya śāsanā-
-dbhavattapasyābhiratā daśā’pi te |
payonidhiṃ paścimametya tattaṭe
sarovaraṃ sandadṛśurmanoharam || 19-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तदा भवत्तीर्थमिदं समागतो
भवो भवत्सेवकदर्शनादृतः ।
प्रकाशमासाद्य पुरः प्रचेतसा-
-मुपादिशद्भक्ततमस्तवस्तवम् ॥ १९-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Lord Shiva came to the lake shore to meet the devoted Prachetas and Lord Shiva enthusiastically taught Rudrageetha which is sung in praise of Lord Narayana.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tadā bhavattīrthamidaṃ samāgato
bhavo bhavatsevakadarśanādṛtaḥ |
prakāśamāsādya puraḥ pracetasā-
-mupādiśadbhaktatamastavastavam || 19-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
स्तवं जपन्तस्तममी जलान्तरे
भवन्तमासेविषतायुतं समाः ।
भवत्सुखास्वादरसादमीष्वियान्
बभूव कालो ध्रुववन्न शीघ्रता ॥ १९-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Singing this hymn, the ten sons did penance in water for ten thousand years.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
stavaṃ japantastamamī jalāntare
bhavantamāseviṣatāyutaṃ samāḥ |
bhavatsukhāsvādarasādamīṣviyān
babhūva kālo dhruvavanna śīghratā || 19-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तपोभिरेषामतिमात्रवर्धिभिः
स यज्ञहिंसानिरतोऽपि पावितः ।
पिताऽपि तेषां गृहयातनारद
प्रदर्शितात्मा भवदात्मतां ययौ ॥ १९-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The deep penance of the Prachetas on Lord, purified their ancestor Venan who destroyed yagnas. Sage Narada went and met Praacheenabarhis and gave knowledge about athman by which he merged with the Lord.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tapobhireṣāmatimātravardhibhiḥ
sa yajñahiṃsānirato’pi pāvitaḥ |
pitā’pi teṣāṃ gṛhayātanārada
pradarśitātmā bhavadātmatāṃ yayau || 19-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
कृपाबलेनैव पुरः प्रचेतसां
प्रकाशमागाः पतगेन्द्रवाहनः ।
विराजि चक्रादिवरायुधांशुभि-
-र्भुजाभिरष्टाभिरुदञ्चितद्युतिः ॥ १९-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Pleased with the deep penance for many years, Lord by virtue of his compassion, appeared before Prachetas in Garuda vahana with eight arms, holding conch, discus and other divine weapons.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kṛpābalenaiva puraḥ pracetasāṃ
prakāśamāgāḥ patagendravāhanaḥ |
virāji cakrādivarāyudhāṃśubhi-
-rbhujābhiraṣṭābhirudañcitadyutiḥ || 19-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
प्रचेतसां तावदयाचतामपि
त्वमेव कारुण्यभराद्वरानदाः ।
भवद्विचिन्ताऽपि शिवाय देहिनां
भवत्वसौ रुद्रनुतिश्च कामदा ॥ १९-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
Lord in Garuda vahana with his limitless mercy, granted boons with goodness in everything & gave the Prachetas boons even without them asking.

*#7 - IMPORTANT*
The greatest boon for us to be born here is to live with the thought of Bhagwan.
Our birth is given by Bhagwan to live for penance.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
pracetasāṃ tāvadayācatāmapi
tvameva kāruṇyabharādvarānadāḥ |
bhavadvicintā’pi śivāya dehināṃ
bhavatvasau rudranutiśca kāmadā || 19-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अवाप्य कान्तां तनयां महीरुहां
तया रमध्वं दशलक्षवत्सरीम् ।
सुतोऽस्तु दक्षो ननु तत्क्षणाच्च मां
प्रयास्यथेति न्यगदो मुदैव तान् ॥ १९-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Being highly pleased with the Prachetas Lord blessed them that they would get the daughter of the trees as their wife. They would lead a happy life with her for ten lakh of years. Also that they would have a son named Daksha and soon thereafter they would attain The Lord.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
avāpya kāntāṃ tanayāṃ mahīruhāṃ
tayā ramadhvaṃ daśalakṣavatsarīm |
suto’stu dakṣo nanu tatkṣaṇācca māṃ
prayāsyatheti nyagado mudaiva tān || 19-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
ततश्च ते भूतलरोधिनस्तरून्
क्रुधा दहन्तो द्रुहिणेन वारिताः ।
द्रुमैश्च दत्तां तनयामवाप्य तां
त्वदुक्तकालं सुखिनोऽभिरेमिरे ॥ १९-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Then the Prachetas who were angered by the dense growth of the trees which were covering the surface of the whole earth and causing obstruction, started to burn them. They were dissuaded by Brahmaa to do so. Obligingly the trees gave them their daughter in marriage and they lived with her happily for the time specified by The Lord.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tataśca te bhūtalarodhinastarūn
krudhā dahanto druhiṇena vāritāḥ |
drumaiśca dattāṃ tanayāmavāpya tāṃ
tvaduktakālaṃ sukhino’bhiremire || 19-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अवाप्य दक्षं च सुतं कृताध्वराः
प्रचेतसो नारदलब्धया धिया ।
अवापुरानन्दपदं तथाविध-
-स्त्वमीश वातालयनाथ पाहिमाम् ॥ १९-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: After the birth of their son Daksha and performing several sacrificial rites and having received the highest knowledge from Sage Naarada they attained liberation.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
avāpya dakṣaṃ ca sutaṃ kṛtādhvarāḥ
pracetaso nāradalabdhayā dhiyā |
avāpurānandapadaṃ tathāvidha-
-stvamīśa vātālayanātha pāhimām || 19-10 ||
